name: steve-lukather-lead
title: Steve Lukather: Dumble ODS lead
author: monzta1
summary: A singing, high-mid Dumble ODS lead voice. Built with no device attached, so it sets only the amp and the scene: storing and any wet blocks are left to you.

steps.reason: Scene-specific request — scene 4 must be active before making the parameter edits below.
Steve Lukather is closely associated with the Dumble Overdrive Special; ODS-100 HRM models the Dumble HRM OD channel, a smooth, singing lead voice matching his tone.
Moderate-high gain for a sustaining, creamy Dumble-style lead without turning to mush.
Balanced low end so the lead stays tight and doesn't muddy the mix.
Healthy midrange for the vocal, cutting-lead character typical of Lukather's tone.
Neutral treble to keep the tone smooth rather than glassy.
Adds clarity and note definition on top without harshness.
Sets a usable output level for the lead voice; adjust to taste for volume balance against other scenes.

assumes: an amp block (instance 1); no reverb, delay or cab assumed
sources: Lukather's lead sound is tied to the Dumble Overdrive Special; ODS-100 HRM models the HRM OD channel
